name: Eternal
driverConfig: 1 × 14.5mm LCP (Liquid Crystal Polymer) dynamic driver with N52 magnet

materials.cable: High-purity OCC copper + single crystal silver

cons: Treble is rolled off — lacks air and sparkle for some
Technical performance is good but not class-leading at the price
Faces very strong competition in the $200–250 range
insight: Eternal was 7Hz’s single-dynamic follow-up to the planar Timeless, using a large 14.5mm LCP driver and striking sapphire-coated glass faceplates. Reviewers generally liked the warm, smooth, easy-going presentation and the premium look, but many felt that at $249 it needed to be more technically impressive to stand out against strong competition. It remains a good choice for listeners who prioritize a non-fatiguing, mid-centric sound and attractive design.
